newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Benguet in deal for Mindanao exploration.
newsitem.headline: Benguet in deal for Mindanao exploration.

text.p: Benguet Corp said on Wednesday it had signed a mineral project agreement with Golden Cycle Philippines Inc (GCPI), a subsidiary of Golden Cycle Gold Corp of the United States, for an exploration project on southern Mindanao island.
The mineral exploration project will be funded equally by the two mining companies, Benguet told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
It added that the joint venture will initially explore for mineral deposits in the eastern part of Mindanao.
"GCPI will bring into this undertaking the foreign investment of its parent company as well as technical expertise and new technologies," Benguet said.
Benguet is the country's oldest mining company. It produces gold, copper concentrates and chromite.
